source: This release is to be used for the beta test of segment #1. Segments The game's planned content has been divided into approximately twelve segments, plus or minus three segments. Each segment contains a portion of story, some new gameplay mechanics, and other content. Our development philosophy involves creating each segment, testing it internally for balance, and then beta testing it for further polish, balance, and review. This allows us to continually assess & expand the game in a controlled manner. Thank you for being part of the Beta Test!
target: 这个版本供第一阶段 Beta 测试使用。 开发阶段 我们将规划中的游戏内容分成约十二个阶段，可能增减三个。每个阶段包含一部分故事、新玩法机制及其他内容。我们的开发理念是：逐一建立各阶段，先进行内部平衡测试，再透过 Beta 测试进一步修润、调整平衡与检视。如此便能在可控的情况下，持续评估及扩充游戏。 感谢你参与 Beta 测试！

source: The sun winks through the pines, scattering beams on the ferns below. Retired couples, active parents, and idle minds wander peacefully along the many trails. source: Testing a major overhaul to the economic balance of the game. In this version, players are required to combine resources from the past, to gain timeline progress in the future.
